manifest.claim_text: Derived-data duplication is controlled for. Primary metric: Hash/lineage audit and performance after deduplication.
manifest.falsified_by: The mandatory control (Keep raw scan and every tractogram, parcellation, preprocessing derivative or augmentation in one split) shows the result survives only without it.
manifest.consequence_if_failed: Minimum interpretation enforced: Different algorithms over one scan are not independent participants
non_goals: This gate does not claim a validated digital twin of any specific person.
This gate does not claim that any admitted operator is neurally realized.
No prospective human TMS/tFUS protocol is implemented or implied (build order stops at item 5; item 6 is out of scope: no IRB, no consent, no participants).

blocking_reasons: hash_lineage_audit: could not run — no lineage records supplied

known_uninformative_fields.git_dirty_whole_tree: a whole-tree dirty flag always reads dirty during a run, because the run writes tracked output (reports/training/*.log, *.jsonl). It cannot distinguish modified source from a run writing its own log, so it is not recorded here and must not be gated on. Use source_dirty_paths.
